test_title: PYST 05: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following sentence/s is/are NOT correct?

i. The detailed estimates of revenue receipts are usually presented in the finance bill.

ii. Non-tax revenue of the central government mainly consists of taxes imposed on goods imported into and exported out of India.

iii. Revenue receipts are redeemable.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ii and iii**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The detailed estimates of revenue receipts are usually presented in the budget, not the finance bill, making statement i incorrect.
 
• Non-tax revenue of the central government mainly consists of income from sources other than taxes, such as profits from public sector enterprises and interest receipts, not taxes on goods imported into and exported out of India. Therefore, statement ii is incorrect.</
